coverage_notes: The paper does not identify an LLM backbone or report vocabulary extension. It does not report experiments removing, mismatching, randomizing, or otherwise corrupting the biological input. MUSK and Virchow2 are described as pretrained encoders, but their trainability within MUPAD is not explicitly stated.

A natural baseline for multimodal conditioning is to concatenate all condition embeddings-image, text, and transcriptomic (RNA)-and feed them into a shared cross-attention module, augmented with modality embeddings to discriminate sources.
Our DCA module instead processes each modality through its own dedicated, parallel attention stream
replacing DCA with shared cross-attention consistently and substantially degrades performance across all tasks and metrics.

representation_comparisons.numbers_stated: FID: shared cross-attention 641.72, 480.12, 439.01 versus MUPAD 554.43, 442.31, 384.54 for image-to-image, text-to-image, and RNA-to-image; relative FID reductions 13.6%, 7.9%, and 12.4%. Cosine similarity: MUPAD 0.43, 0.23, 0.18 versus 0.38, 0.19, 0.162.
representation_comparisons.result_summary: The decoupled cross-attention interface outperformed shared cross-attention across image-to-image, text-to-image, and RNA-to-image generation.

evidence.quote: Directly fusing text, RNA, and image features hurts performance because these modalities carry information at very different scales and semantics.

representation_rationale.summary: The authors argue against directly sharing one fusion space because text, RNA, and image features differ in scale and semantics.

evidence.quote: This design lets the network dedicate separate parameters to each modality, preserving their unique biological characteristics while enabling flexible any-modality conditioning.

representation_rationale.summary: Separate attention streams preserve modality-specific characteristics and support conditioning on any modality.

evidence.quote: Raw RNA-seq counts were normalized to TPM, filtered to remove housekeeping and mitochondrial genes, and compressed into 331 pathway-level enrichment scores using established pan-cancer gene signatures 61 , yielding biologically interpretable conditioning inputs.

representation_rationale.summary: RNA is represented as pathway-level enrichment scores to provide biologically interpretable conditioning inputs.

evidence.quote: Both bulk and ST profiles are compressed into the same 331 pathway-level scores, enabling zero-shot transfer of the pretrained priors.

representation_rationale.summary: Using the same pathway-level representation for bulk and spatial transcriptomics enables transfer of pretrained priors.

evidence.quote: the CNN spatial alignment preserves the fine-grained histological texture information critical for high-fidelity pathology image synthesis

representation_rationale.summary: The CNN alignment objective is chosen to preserve fine-grained spatial texture.

evidence.quote: MLP-based global alignment is insufficient for capturing the fine-grained spatial structure of histological images.

representation_rationale.summary: The authors report that global MLP alignment does not adequately capture fine-grained histological structure.
